title: cirsium pyrenaicum var. longespinosum
intro: Cirsium pyrenaicum var. longespinosum, commonly known as the long-spined thistle, is a plant species within the thistle genus. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, promote wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of Cirsium pyrenaicum var. longespinosum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
